name: Lines after `then` or `do` at the width of a case body end the branch (Scala 3 syntax)
text:
object P:
  def f(t: Any, c: Boolean): Int = t match
    case _: String =>
      if c then
      println("then")
      1
    case _ =>
      while c do
      println("do")
      2

name: A leading operator after a case body closes the nested match it is not deeper than (Scala 3 syntax)
text:
def f =
  a
  || b.match
    case B =>
      c.match
        case C => d
      || e
    case _ =>
      g
  || h

name: A leading operator the case region keeps continues the case body (Scala 3 syntax)
text:
def f =
  a
  || b.match
      case B => c
      case _ =>
        d
    || e

name: A case body continues after a line that closes its region (Scala 3 syntax)
text:
def f = x match
  case a =>
      b
    c
  case _ => d
